ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
pitch deck teardowns helps post-seed startup founders go from struggle to articulate their unique value proposition to secure funding with confidence.

ONBOARDING
1. Define who pitch deck teardowns is for and the problem it solves.
2. Shape your core message so pitch deck teardowns can tailor output.
3. Generate your first result and refine as you go.

EMPTY STATE
1. No audience defined yet. Start by telling pitch deck teardowns who you're building for.
2. No message saved yet. Build your setup to generate output.
3. No output yet. Generate your first result.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Brain saved. Output ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Build Brain
2. Review Brain
3. Generate Positioning
4. Generate Landing
5. Generate UX
6. Refine Message
7. Compare Outputs
8. Save Brain
